content.title: Click inside the security modal body without closing it
content.intent: Prove clicking inside the modal body does not dismiss the open security modal.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: negative testing for an interaction that must not dismiss the modal; state_flow for preserving the modal-open state after an in-body click. strength=2 by risk judgement because no money, auth, or data-loss factors apply; no covering-array sweep was needed because the path varies by one disallowed interaction.
